provenance.instrument: Borough of Lansdale Code Chapter 405 Zoning (Ord. No. 1393, 11-16-1988, as amended), as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 code date 2026-05-20 (breadcrumb). New Laws for Chapter 405 on 2026-11-14: Ord. 2012 'Residential B&C amendments' and Ord. 2013 'TOD text amendment' (2026), PDF only, not read.
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360 breadcrumb 'Code 2026-05-20'. Two 2026 zoning amendments (Residential B and C, TOD) are listed as New Laws, not yet in the code text.
provenance.code_caution: Two 2026 zoning amendments are listed as New Laws for Chapter 405 and were not read (PDF only): 'Residential B&C amendments' (Ord. 2012) and a TOD text amendment (Ord. 2013). The first may change the Class B and Class C Residential rules below.
checks: 'Accessory dwelling units shall be permitted by right attached to or contained within single-family detached homes only' (405-1913B). Not in a separate building, not joined by a corridor or breezeway (405-1913E)
Occupants are limited to the parents, grandparents, step-parents or step-grandparents of the occupants of the house, or the spouse, sibling or partner of one of them. At most two people (405-1913G)
The house is owner-occupied and the owner's primary residence. The unit may not be rented (405-1913F, I)

A deed restriction is recorded with the Montgomery County Recorder of Deeds. A license to operate is renewed every year by January 1, with inspections twice a year. The second kitchen is removed within six months after the approved occupant leaves (405-1913A, H, J)

One more off-street parking space, unless the house already has at least one space beyond its own requirement. Utilities are routed through the house. A separate entrance that does not face the street, no separate address or mailbox (405-1913B, D, K, L)

Lot area per dwelling unit: Class A 9,000 sq ft (standard option), Class B 5,600, Class C 4,500 for a single-family detached dwelling. Where the block has existing homes, the block median governs (405-404, 405-504, 405-506, 405-604, 405-606). Whether the ADU counts as a dwelling unit for this is not said. Ask the Code Enforcement Officer
An accessory building is 'subordinate, uninhabitable' by definition, so a unit in a detached garage or outbuilding is not allowed (405-201)
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Borough of Lansdale Department of Code Enforcement. Read on eCode360 (LA0393) in a browser, one page at a time, on 2026-11-14. Code search (all content, New Laws included) for 'accessory apartment', 'accessory dwelling', 'in-law', ECHO, 'elder cottage', granny, 'family dwelling', relative, 'housekeeping unit', caretaker, 'tenant house' and 'guest house' found 405-1913 and the ADU definition (405-201), and a conversion of a single-family dwelling to apartment conversion units in Professional Office District B (405-900E, excerpt). Read in full: 405-1913, the definitions page (ADU, accessory building), Class A, B and C Residential (Articles IV to VI) and Residential Apartment (Article VII). Not read: Professional Office A and B, LPO, Commercial, Business, B-2, Industrial and the overlay districts, accessory structures (405-1904) and parking (405-1703).

term.note: 'A suite attached to or contained within the principal dwelling unit on a lot that houses certain family members of the occupant(s) of the principal dwelling unit, and may contain separate cooking facilities' (Ord. No. 2018-1907).

status.note: By right, attached to or inside a single-family detached home, only for parents, grandparents and step-relatives of the household (or their spouse, sibling or partner), at most two people, owner-occupied, not rented.

scope_by_use.note: The ADU is allowed with single-family detached homes only. Class A, B and C list single-family detached dwellings. The Residential Apartment District does not. Other districts' use lists were not read.

status_outside.note: Where single-family detached dwellings are not permitted, no ADU rule applies.

path.note: 'Permitted by right.' A recorded deed restriction and an accessory dwelling unit license to operate, renewed every year.

fallback_path.note: Relief from a district rule is a variance from the Zoning Hearing Board.

value.name: Two-family duplex dwelling in Class B or C Residential
value.conditions: Two-family duplex dwellings are permitted. Lot area per dwelling unit 5,600 sq ft (B) or 4,500 sq ft (C), side yards 8 ft, rear 20 ft. 'Conversion of single-family detached dwelling to other uses' is listed as not permitted.
value.note: Lot figures are two units at the per-unit area. Since conversion of a single-family detached dwelling to other uses is not permitted, this is a path for a new duplex, not for converting a house. Ask the Code Enforcement Officer.

value.name: Conversion of a single-family dwelling to apartment conversion units in Professional Office District B
value.conditions: Listed as a permitted use with conditions that were not read.
value.note: Read from a search excerpt only. The conditions and lot rules were not read. Ask the Code Enforcement Officer.

zoning_districts.note: Districts read that permit single-family detached dwellings.

value.condition: Occupants limited to the parents, grandparents, step-parents or step-grandparents of the occupants of the house, or the spouse, sibling or partner of one of those relatives. At most two people.
The house is owner-occupied and the owner's primary residence. The unit may not be leased or rented.

Deed restriction recorded with the Montgomery County Recorder of Deeds. Annual license to operate (by January 1), inspections twice a year, owner reimburses enforcement costs. The second kitchen is removed within six months after the approved occupant leaves.

Attached and interconnected with the house, any connecting door open from both sides. A separate entrance that does not face the street (on a corner lot, not the street the main entrance faces). No separate address or mailbox. Outside changes keep the look of a single-family detached house. The addition meets the house's dimensional rules.
All utilities for the unit are routed through the house.

types_allowed.note: 'Attached to or contained within single-family detached homes only.' 'Shall not be located in a separate freestanding building joined to the principal dwelling by a corridor or breezeway.'

owner_occupancy.note: 'The principal dwelling unit shall [be] owner-occupied, and shall be the primary residence of the owner of the property.'

occupancy.value: At most two people: parents, grandparents, step-parents or step-grandparents of the occupants of the house, or the spouse, sibling or partner of one of them.

max_adus.note: 'An accessory dwelling unit' with the house. No number is stated.

spaces_required.note: 'An accessory dwelling unit requires one new, additional off-street parking space.' Not needed if the house already has at least one space beyond its own requirement.

min_lot_sqft.note: Standard option, per dwelling unit, where two or fewer homes are on the block. Where more than two are, the block median lot area governs (405-404A). Width 60 ft. Impervious 45%.

setback_front_ft.note: 24 ft minimum, 30 ft maximum. On a block with homes, the block median.

lot_area_per_unit_sqft.note: 'The minimum lot area shall be 9,000 square feet per dwelling unit.' Applies to the ADU only if it counts as a dwelling unit. Ask.

min_lot_sqft.note: Single-family detached, per dwelling unit. Width 45 ft. Existing homes use the block median (405-506). Impervious 75%.

setback_front_ft.note: Block median of permitted uses, 24 ft where the block has no homes.

lot_area_per_unit_sqft.note: Applies to redevelopment 'at a density greater than existed prior'. Applies to the ADU only if it counts as a dwelling unit. Ask.

min_lot_sqft.note: Single-family detached, per dwelling unit. Width 32 ft. Existing homes use the block median (405-606). Impervious 75%.

setback_front_ft.note: Block median of permitted uses, 24 ft where the block has no homes.

lot_area_per_unit_sqft.note: Applies to redevelopment 'at a density greater than existed prior'. Applies to the ADU only if it counts as a dwelling unit. Ask.
